resolution.question: Will Brightline Software's three co-founders decide whether the January price increase is going ahead, and tell the team, before the all-hands on the 18th?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if, before the hard cutoff, the persistent event history shows that all three co-founders have agreed on whether the January price increase is going ahead, and that a message has been sent to the team (e.g., via email or announcement) informing them of the decision. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
